kaikki_vikisozluk.e: سُورَنْجَان or سُورِنْجَان • (sūranjān or sūrinjān) m
kaikki_vikisozluk.t: Via either Middle Persian or Aramaic, attested in Classical Syriac ܣܘܪܢܓܐܢ (/⁠sūringān⁠/), ܣܘܪܝܢܓܐܢ (/⁠sūringān⁠/) and ܣܘܪܝܢܓ (/⁠sūring⁠/), apparently before *ܣܘܪܢܓ (/⁠sūrang⁠/), from Akkadian [script needed] (šarnagu), also found in Ugaritic 𐎘𐎗𐎐𐎖 (ṯrnq).
